{{Top|leg}}
A '''Catch-cable''' was an articulated metallic tentacle that extended from a port in the torso of particular [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droids]]. Some models contained multiple catch-cables. The [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]] was equipped with catch-cables.
